task_description: Implement the cross-screen one-click dialing system with four components: Go relay server, Tauri v2 PC desktop client, Kotlin Android app, and TypeScript MV3 browser extension. All components communicate via WebSocket + JSON protocol with PIN-based grouping.

verification.summary: All 4 components build and test successfully. Relay: go build + 28 tests pass. PC: vite build + 11 tests pass (Rust backend needs GTK libs for full build, cargo check passes). Android: assembleDebug + 33 tests pass (requires Java 17). Extension: webpack build + 24 tests pass, dist 28KB.
